ITEM 1 | Pale white cubes, roughly 2.5 cm across, firm, slightly translucent edges, smooth cut faces, clustered at upper left of plate beside the potatoes | 95
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown roasted potato chunks with crisp, browned edges and irregular cut faces, some with green herb flecks, about 2-3 cm pieces, piled in a loose group at top center | 120
ITEM 3 | Halved and whole green sprout-like vegetables with charred, darker leaf edges and pale yellow-green cut centers, glossy with a light oily sheen, partly wilted, sitting in a cluster at lower left of plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Dark green wilted leafy greens, limp and glossy, scattered under and among the sprouts at lower left | 25
ITEM 5 | Single small wilted dark green leaf piece, folded, glossy, at bottom center near the sprouts | 12
ITEM 6 | Browned, slightly crumbly patty with a dense textured surface, reddish-brown color with darker crust, about 8 cm across and 2 cm thick, at right side of plate | 110
ITEM 7 | Finely shredded white topping, pale and fluffy, scattered over the patty at its upper right, about 4 cm area | 15
ITEM 8 | Thin orange shredded carrot strands, bright orange, scattered across the patty's top and edges | 6
